# onpager_rbac_role (Resource)

Manage one custom native RBAC role and its complete permission set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_rbac_role" "example" {
  key             = "configuration_reader"
  name            = "Configuration reader"
  description     = "Read teams and services without changing configuration"
  scope_type      = "tenant"
  permission_keys = ["teams.read", "services.read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Immutable role key matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$`, unique in the tenant. Release-controlled built-in role keys are reserved. Changing the key replaces the role; duplicate-key creation never updates an existing role.
- `name` (String) Nonempty valid UTF-8 display name without NUL or leading/trailing whitespace. Display names need not be unique.
- `permission_keys` (Set of String) Complete set of exact native permission keys. Explicit `[]` creates or clears an empty draft; `null` is invalid. Unknown, reserved and scope-incompatible keys are rejected by the API. No wildcard or implicit grants exist. Roles assigned to service accounts must not contain human-only permissions.
- `scope_type` (String) Immutable role scope: `tenant` or `team`. Permission keys must be custom-grantable in this scope. Changing it replaces the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Valid UTF-8 description without NUL. Omission or `null` defaults to an empty string; explicit empty string clears the description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable nonzero canonical lowercase OnPager UUID.
- `revision` (Number) Whole-role revision, validated against the API's strong numeric ETag and used in `If-Match` for replace and delete. Independent of tenant policy and assignment revisions; stale revisions report conflicts without retrying.

## Import

Import using the custom role UUID. Import reads the role and its whole-role
ETag. Built-in roles cannot be managed or imported.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_rbac_role.example
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_rbac_role.example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```

## Lifecycle

Changing immutable `key` or `scope_type` replaces the role. Built-in role keys
are reserved; duplicate-key creation reports a conflict.

Updates replace the complete permission set and metadata atomically. An explicit
empty permission set is a draft with no permissions. The API validates
permission catalog membership, eligibility for custom grants and scope
compatibility. Roles assigned to service accounts cannot include human-only
permissions. Creating a role does not assign it to any principal.

Writes use the role's strong numeric ETag. A stale revision reports a conflict
and requires a new plan; assignment and tenant IAM policy revisions cannot be
used in its place.

Destroy deletes an unused custom role. Assignments and configured defaults can
block deletion; remove those dependencies explicitly. Failed deletion retains
state.

## Permissions

Requires tenant grants `roles.create`, `roles.read`, `roles.update` and
`roles.delete`. Service accounts require these explicit native grants.
